okinawa.overview: Okinawa offers modest but rewarding day hikes, mostly in the subtropical Yanbaru forest in the north and on coastal paths. Trails are short, from easy boardwalks to the muddy old logging road up Yonaha-dake, the island's highest peak, where hikers turn back at the ninth station marker. Winter is best, avoiding summer heat and typhoons.

new-orleans.overview: Walking here means short, flat nature trails and urban parks. Couturie Forest in City Park has a mile-long path under the canopy. Barataria Preserve in Jean Lafitte National Historical Park has swamp boardwalks, but most closed in 2026 for rebuilding after Hurricane Ida.

rajaampat.overview: Raja Ampat is famous for its water, but the islands have short walks. The best known are the wooden stairs to the karst viewpoint at Piaynemo and the steeper rock scramble to the view at Wayag. Short jungle trails on Waigeo lead to bird viewing areas. Access is by boat.
